policies.ignore: Never respond to incoming trade; all other player decisions also remain passive.
policies.accept: Before End cycle, accept each legal active incoming trade offer using its normal command; make no other player choices.
policies.decline: Before End cycle, decline each legal active incoming trade offer using its normal command; make no other player choices.

method.cohort: Eight identical seeds per policy;24 campaigns total. Source is pinned and unmodified. No older-engine or balance comparator.
method.termination: First winner or LAST_TURN120; no extra campaigns.
method.decisionOrder: Incoming trade sorted by createdTurn, numeric offer ID, then proposer ID. Re-query legal response before each command. Offers without a legal response remain pending.
method.reload: At each reached checkpoint, execute the full next policy round from structuredClone and JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state)); compare command results and complete serialized states. Probes are excluded from cohort event/cycle totals.
method.checks: Validate every initial/post-command/post-End-cycle state, finite nonnegative faction credits/minerals/science/orders, bilateral treaty flags, explicit accepted-offer authorization for every player treaty opening, immutable offer terms, no lost pending receipts, no second resolution, no post before a prior quiet deadline, valid quiet-phase forecasts and AI intents.
method.financialMeasurement: Accept/decline commands check actual recipient/proposer credit deltas and order cost. Campaign expiry totals are30-credit refund obligations derived from resolved offer receipts, not isolated treasury deltas: AI spending and income share the same End-cycle operation. No engine instrumentation or synthetic counterfactual is used.
method.denominators: Offer counts are distinct trade offer IDs within each campaign, including finalized records later pruned from the bounded save archive. A treaty observation is one player-rival pair after a main-cohort state check. Quiet observations count pair states whose deadline is still future. Resource checks count four fields for all four factions per checked state.
method.limits: These are intentionally passive policy measurements, not human difficulty/win rates or an earlier-version balance comparison. Neither policy initiates or cancels treaties, moves ships, develops colonies, researches, declares war, responds to peace, or uses Hold. Completed games can retain pending escrow; this is reported, not treated as an invented refund. Eight matched seeds do not estimate a population win probability.
